PHCs in Himachal Pradesh
*261. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to upgrade the existing Primary
Health Centres in Himachal Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the details of funds received from
the World Bank for upgradation of existing
PHCs during the last three years; and
(e) the funds utilised, so far, for the
purpose?
Ayurvedic System of Medicine
*262. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of measures taken by
Government to encourage the Ayurvedic
System of Medicine;
(b) whether the Ayurvedic drug
manufacturers are finding it difficult to
withstand the competition from the
Allopathic System of Medicine; and
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
to reduce the cost of production of Ayurvedic
medicines?
Uniform stamp duty
*263. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
reduction in stamp duty on real estate deals
to a uniform level all over the country;
(b) whether this move is aimed at
attracting more investment in the real estate
sector;
(c) whether stamp duty is a State subject;
and
(d) if so, how Government propose to
overcome the objections from the States?

Sethusamudram Canal Project
*264. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be
pleased to state:
(a) whether work on the
Sethusamudram Canal Project with an initial
investment of Rs. 200 to Rs. 230 crore will
begin soon;
(b) whether the report of the National
Environmental Engineering Research
Institute (NEERI), which is conducting
techno-economic and environmental impact
assessment studies for the project, has been
received by Government;
(c) whether the project was initially
proposed in 1860 and three feasibility
studies have been conducted in 1955, 1983
and 1996 for the project besides a detailed
feasibility study conducted by NEERI,
Nagpur; and
(d) if so, by when this project is likely to
start?
Purchase of tobacco
*265. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of tobacco purchased
from tobacco farmers through Tobacco
Board since 1998-99, year-wise and
State-wise;
(b) whether Government are aware that
Tobacco Board is acting in a partisan manner
with regard to purchase of tobacco from
Karnataka farmers;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
of Karnataka has requested Government to
purchase the tobacco on the basis of
production capacity of the States; and
(d) if so, the details of the action taken in
this regard?
Schemes for the welfare of disabled
people
†*266. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the schemes and amount
allocated for the welfare of handicapped
persons during the last three years,
State-wise;
(b) the details of the funds utilised,
scheme-wise and State-wise;
(c) the number of handicapped persons
benefited under the scheme, State-wise;
(d) the number of institutions connected
with the schemes;
(e) whether there is any proposal to
increase their number;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Marketing of Levonorge by Cipla
*267. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
SHRI KHAN GHUFRAN
ZAHIDI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Cipla is
marketing Levonorge without DCGI's
approval;
(b) whether it is also a fact that M/s
Contech Devices has filed a complaint
against Cipla; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken by Government against the company?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Funds for construction of roads,
bridges etc. to Chhattisgarh
†*268. SHRI JHUMUK LAL
BHENDIA: Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allocated to
Chhattisgarh during this year under various
schemes for construction of roads, bridges
and culverts in tribal areas;
(b) whether additional funds are
proposed to be allocated; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

Export earning
1789. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the estimated total export earning
during the current financial year;
(b) the level of growth expected;
(c) whether it is a fact that export earning
is affected by stiff competition; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to increase
export earning by giving incentives to
exporters?
Closed/sick industrial units
1790. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of industrial units having
been closed, declared sick or running in loss
upto 31st October, 2002;
(b) the number of industries closed,
declared sick and running in loss upto
28th February, 2001; and
(c) the number of workers rendered
unemployed in both the cases?
Compensation to tobacco barn owners
1791. SHRI NANDI  YELLAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether as a part of phasing out of
tobacco production, tobacco barns have
been closed in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
number of barns closed in the country,
State-wise;
(c) if so, whether any compensation has
been paid to tobacco barn owners;
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(e) whether any financial relief has been
given to tobacco cultivators for providing
them incentives for raising alternative crops
in the form of input-subsidy; and
(f) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Export prospects in Latin America
1792. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has

394
I:\WIN2\SESSION\6107RS.pm5 394
been drawn to news-item captioned, "Export
promotion drive soon—Exporters see good
business in Latin America", which appeared
in the Economic Times, dated the
26th August, 2002;
(b) whether our exporters are mounting
a major export promotion drive in Latin
America;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the help rendered by Government or
the Export Promotion Council to encourage
exporters in their drive?
Demand for domestic products
1793. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the demand for domestic
products in the year 2002-03 has been
extremely low;
(b) if so, whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Global slow down to affect domestic
demand, exports", which appeared in the
Economic Times, dated the 19th August,
2002;
(c) if so, Government's reaction to this
report; and
(d) the steps Government propose to take
to improve the demand for domestic goods
in the country as also their exports?
Assistance to State Governments for
setting up SEZs
1794. SHRI C.O. POULOSE:
SHRI PRASANT A CHA TTER-
JEE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
assistance to the State Governments for
setting up Special Export Zones in the
country;
(b) if so, the number of zones intended
to be set up, State-wise;
(c) whether Government have received
any request from the Government of Kerala
for Central assistance in this regard; and
(d) if so, the action taken by Government
thereon?
Guidelines for IMFL producing MNCs
1795. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
SHRI LAJP AT RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have framed
any rules/guidelines under which MNCs
producing IMFL in India are required to
seek Government's approval before setting
up or acquiring new plants;
(b) if so, the broad outlines thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that M/s Seagram
Mfg. Ltd., a multinational company has taken
over Oceanic Distilleries Pvt. Ltd., Dindori,
District Nasik without Government's
approval; and
(d) if so, the action Government propose
to take in the matter?
Report on Intellectual Property Rights
and Development Policy
1796. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Commis-
sion on Intellectual Property Rights
appointed by the British Secretary of State,
of which Dr. R. A. Mashelker was a
Member, has submitted its report titled,

395

'Intellectual Property Rights and
Development Policy'; and
(b) if so, the details of major
recommendations contained in the report and
Government's decision on each of them?
